title: Nested Clustered Optimization Is One End of a Schur Bridge, and the Interior Is Sometimes Provably Better
abstract: arXiv:2609.21271v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nested clustered optimization allocates within each cluster from the cluster's own covariance block and then across the resulting cluster portfolios. Block inversion says the unconstrained minimum-variance portfolio has the same two-tier shape, with each block replaced by its Schur complement against every other asset. Conditioning instead on one knot from each other cluster truncates the conditioning set in the manner of a Vecchia approximation, and we give the rank-one model of cross-cluster dependence under which it is exact. Damping the complement by $\gamma\in[0,1]$ then gives a bridge with nested clustered optimization at $\gamma=0$ and the global optimum at $\gamma=1$, with no linear solve larger than a cluster or the number of clusters. Under estimation error the optimal $\gamma$ can be strictly interior and full coupling can remain optimal, and we give the local theorem at the minimum-variance end with exact examples of both, in

translated_title: 嵌套聚类优化是Schur桥的一端，而桥梁内部有时可证明更优
translated_abstract: 嵌套聚类优化先在每个聚类内部依据该聚类自身的协方差块进行资产配置，随后在得到的各聚类组合之间进行配置。块矩阵求逆表明，无约束最小方差组合具有相同的两层结构，只是每个块被替换为相对于其余所有资产的Schur补。若改为以每个其他聚类中的一个节点作为条件，则以Vecchia近似的方式截断了条件集，我们给出了跨聚类依赖的秩一模型，在该模型下这种做法是精确的。用 γ∈[0,1] 对Schur补进行阻尼衰减，便得到一座“桥梁”：γ=0 时对应嵌套聚类优化，γ=1 时对应全局最优，且所有线性求解的规模均不超过单个聚类的大小或聚类的数量。在存在估计误差的情况下，最优的 γ 可以严格位于区间内部，而完全耦合也可能保持最优；我们给出了最小方差端的局部定理，并针对这两种情形提供了精确的例子……
tldr: 该论文提出一个基于 γ 阻尼 Schur 补的“桥梁”框架，将嵌套聚类优化（γ=0）与全局最小方差组合（γ=1）连接起来，并证明在存在估计误差时最优 γ 可严格取内部值，此时桥梁内部的解可被证明优于两端。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a γ-damped Schur bridge connecting nested clustered optimization (γ=0) to the global minimum-variance portfolio (γ=1), and proves that under estimation error the optimal γ can be strictly interior, making the bridge's interior sometimes provably better than either endpoint.
